displayName: 海天使薄纱 Sea Angel Gauze
description: Original Sea Angel Gauze is a simplified lavender swimming companion informed by general Clione sea-angel morphology, with a translucent spindle body, two broad lateral swimming parapodia, two small head lobes and warm apricot internal patches. The palette, gentle light-speck interaction and nine-state choreography are original stylizations. The reference is not identified here as Clione limacina, and this artwork is not a scientific species plate, official character or popularity claim. Motion uses paired-fin strokes, directional swimming, body and tail follow-through, a quiet hover and a soft buoyant rise.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
